_note: What one query actually costs on each provider, for the cost column in the results explorer. A null price is one that has NOT been measured or quoted — the explorer renders those as 'not measured' rather than guessing. Do not fill these in from memory; use an invoice or the vendor's live pricing page, and put the source and date in.

tavily.basis: measured: 150 queries burned 1,000 credits at ~6.7 credits/query

serper.basis: approximate, from the published per-1k-search price

firecrawl.basis: approximate, from the credit model already encoded in core/adapters/firecrawl.ts
